title: Pass0bSpatialResult
description: Pass 0b Spatial: per-group spatial configuration extraction

groups.description: Spatial configuration for each group in the lesson

group_number.description: Group number from the lesson structure

position.description: Primary body position for this group

part.description: Body part in contact with surface

surface.description: Surface being contacted: floor, wall, chair

qualifier.description: Optional detail about the contact (e.g., 'standing close to pelvis')

holds.description: Body-part-to-body-part contact (one part holding or touching another)

part_b.description: Second body part being held or contacted

constraints.description: Movement restrictions — parts that must stay fixed or follow a rule

rule.description: What the constraint is (e.g., 'stay flat on floor', 'fixed length to feet')

primary_movements.description: The main movements explored in this group, described in plain physical language

config_signature.description: Normalized one-line summary using canonical body part vocabulary: position | holds | constraints | movement

config_detail.description: Detailed one-line summary using specific terms from the lesson: position | holds | constraints | movement
